name: lensqa
description: Frontend Quality Cloud — visual, a11y, performance, and runtime QA

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lensqa/shared && npm run build -w @lensqa/sdk && npm run build -w @lensqa/runner && npm run build -w @lensqa/web
